data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with various Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Include a line chart for LLM cost over time
Use a bar chart for stage completion rates
Display success rate trends using an area chart

features.title: Results Visualization
features.description: Show real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Use real data to populate charts
Ensure metrics are up-to-date and accurate
Provide context for the data presented

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Display cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Use charts to represent cost tracking data
Visualize sandboxing and learning metrics
Ensure data is accurate and up-to-date

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include Chart.js library in the HTML file
Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates
Ensure charts are interactive and visually appealing

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Create a clear and informative visualization of the 8-stage pipeline
Use appropriate chart types to represent each stage
Ensure the visualization is easy to understand

features.title: HTML Presentation Template
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Use contract_analytics_dashboard.html, lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html, and artemis_complete_demo.html as templates
Embed CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js within the HTML file
Ensure the presentation is professional and cohesive

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a radar chart to display code quality metrics
Include TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Ensure the chart is easy to interpret

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a pie chart to represent supervisor integration
Ensure data is accurately represented
Make the chart interactive for better engagement

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Include controls for manual navigation
Ensure navigation is intuitive and responsive

features.title: HERO Section: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create an introductory slide explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Include a clear and concise description of Artemis
Use engaging visuals to capture attention
Ensure the introduction sets the stage for the rest of the presentation

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Use a visually appealing gradient background
Implement smooth slide transitions
Ensure the design is consistent and professional
